parsed.post: Keeping my latest run (1.006103). Adding WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to the depth-8, LR=0.08 configuration significantly improved val_bpb. It seems warmup helps stabilize the higher learning rate. Next, I'll try reducing the TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget.
parsed.description: Adding WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 and halving TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimizer steps, building on the success of the warmup and the potential benefit of more updates within the time limit.
